name: Dreamsect Rebel Saga - Episode 1: Days of Innocence
source:
This is a world inhabited those called "Paranormals" and "Casuals." After a millennia-long hostility between the two escalates into an all-out war, the future of the world falls to the hands of those who seek  the "truth" and "justice."

[From [url=https://aquasoft.itch.io/days-of-innocence-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个世界居住着被称为“超常者”与“常人”的两类人群。当双方延续千年的敌意升级为全面战争后，世界的未来落入了那些追寻“真相”与“正义”之人的手中。

[引自[url=https://aquasoft.itch.io/days-of-innocence-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
